page: Amazon Web Services c9g.8xlarge is a compute-optimized server powered by the AWS Graviton Gen9 processor family. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on the ARM64 architecture using the AWS Neoverse-V3 (ARMv9) model, operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The processor configuration includes 64 KB of L1d cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and 48 MB of L3 cache. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It operates on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, lacks local storage, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 17 Gbps. No GPUs are included.

Benchmark results indicate strong compute and memory subsystem performance. The server achieves top-tier status in single-core and multi-core Geekbench evaluations, as well as in software compilation tasks using Clang. Single-threaded compression and decompression tasks, such as gzip and bzip3, also rank in the top tier. Memory subsystem testing reveals a top-tier PassMark memory score and strong read-only cached memory bandwidth of 4319.78 GB/sec, though uncached large-block read and write speeds fall into the average category. For database and web workloads, the instance demonstrates top-tier performance in static web serving throughput and PassMark database operations, alongside strong Redis SET operation throughput.

Given its high physical core density and dedicated ARMv9 architecture, the c9g.8xlarge offers high compute resource density relative to its memory footprint. The lack of hyperthreading (1.0 thread per core) ensures predictable execution times, making it highly efficient for compute-bound workloads. This hardware profile is highly suited for software compilation, text processing, static web serving, and database operations. It also supports moderate machine learning tasks, demonstrating strong performance in text generation for medium-sized (7B) language models, though it is not equipped for large-scale (70B) model inference due to the absence of dedicated GPU hardware.
description: The Amazon Web Services c9g.8xlarge is a compute-optimized server featuring 32 dedicated physical cores on the ARM64 architecture, powered by the 3.3 GHz AWS Neoverse-V3 (ARMv9) processor. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, providing a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio, and operates on the Nitro hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 17 Gbps. The instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPUs. Performance benchmarks show top-tier results in software compilation, single-core and multi-core Geekbench tests, static web serving throughput, and database operations. It also delivers strong performance in Redis operations and medium-model LLM text generation. This server is highly suited for compute-intensive workloads, including CI/CD pipelines, web serving, and database management, offering high resource density and predictable performance without hyperthreading.
